mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_messages (channel_binding_id, idempotency_key, external_message_id, role, content, content_hash, delivery_status, sent_at) VALUES (#{channelBindingId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{externalMessageId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{contentHash}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{sentAt}) ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) WHERE role = 'USER' DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation_messages SET delivery_status = #{deliveryStatus}, sent_at = #{sentAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND role = 'ASSISTANT'
